name: development
summary: Plan with the owner, build test-first, review with clean context, land through a pull request.

phases.name: plan
phases.instruction: Read each record the change surfaced; cite those you build on in the plan's uses and list the rest under ### Considered with a line on why each does not apply. Interview the owner and fill in Problem, Outcome, Out of scope, UX and Data. UX starts with No UI change and a reason, or lists each mockup under ### Mockups with a ### Neighbours list; attach the owner's decision naming each mockup. Data starts with None, or run the understanding-check skill and attach its record and the owner's decision that references it. Write the plan with `board call changes.plan` and attach the owner's signed plans/decision/v1 whose refs name the plan.

checks.subject: data
checks.remedy: Run the understanding-check skill with the owner on the plan's Data section, attach its record with `board call changes.attach --path {change} --ref <record>`, and ask the owner to sign a plans/decision/v1 whose refs name it.

phases.name: build
phases.instruction: Start one builder in a fresh agent from `board call changes.brief --path {change}`; its first message begins with brief_line, then the brief. Build test-first, commit, and record the head with `board call changes.attach --path {change} --head <sha>`. Attach each task. Run {suite} on the head and attach the run. Before advancing, ask the owner two of each understanding check's predict or edge questions again, worded differently, and add them to its rechecks.

checks.remedy: When {suite} is empty, the repository names no check suite: name one with `board call changes.attach --path {change} --suite /suites/<name>`, define one with `board call runs.define`, or ask the owner to waive this check. Otherwise run {suite} on {head} with `board call runs.run` and attach the run.

phases.name: review
phases.instruction: Review {head} with clean context: run `board call review.run` on a brief whose subject is the change, so the reviewer reads the plan as the spec and the controls on the plan's paths, and attach the report. The gate refuses a diff that edits a file outside the plan's paths; add the file with `board call changes.plan`, or revert the edit. Fix every critical or high finding, record the new head and review again.

phases.name: land
phases.instruction: Add What the tests prove and What the tests do not prove to the plan. Draft the pull request with `board call changes.pr --path {change}`, read pr.md and fix what is wrong, fix each path in `unreadable` and draft again or say why in the body, then run the command it returns in a POSIX shell from a checkout on {head}. Record the pull request with `board call github.ref --ref <owner>/<repo>#<number>` and attach it with --pull. Merging happens outside Board; advancing from land ends the change in done.

sections: What the tests do not prove
